modules.name: Repo-kit
modules.summary: Personal instructions, shared skills, portable governance and executable tools have distinct owners. Consumer repositories retain local policy, meaning and evidence.

modules.name: Authority & decisions
modules.summary: Root governance defines kit ownership. ADRs retain accepted trade-offs; optional Campaigns link uncertainty, work and evidence without owning them.

modules.name: Candidate evidence
modules.summary: Local friction, reviewed upstream ideas and downstream deltas are inputs for owner review. Observation or copying alone does not authorize promotion or propagation.

modules.name: Shared agent skills
modules.summary: Upstream and locally maintained workflows, pinned by exact source hashes and delivered independently of governance.

modules.name: Portable governance
modules.summary: Copier delivers rules, checks and agent bootstrap from template/. True seeds remain consumer-owned; updates reconcile from the consumer's recorded _commit.

modules.name: Repo Workbench
modules.summary: Optional executable tools for architecture discussion, recorded-session review, usage analysis and inspectable MCP interactions. Runtime delivery is independent of skills and Copier.

modules.name: Project & user ownership
modules.summary: User skill installations support project work; projects retain language, paths, policy, checks, maps and curated evidence. These are distinct delivery destinations, grouped here as the ownership boundary.

modules.name: Guarded skill delivery
modules.summary: Review diff → validate bundle hashes → sync user installation. Refuse unmanaged collisions or edited/missing managed files; stage replacements and retain the previous installation for recovery.

modules.name: Rules & local bindings
modules.summary: Portable doctrine defines document/work lifecycle and authority. Constitution, index, backlog, glossary and configuration are seeded, then adapted by each consumer.

modules.name: Checks & agent bootstrap
modules.summary: Consumer configuration drives mechanical documentation checks, profile-scoped authoring checks and agent symlink setup. Checks enforce configured structure; local owners retain semantic judgment.

modules.name: Architecture discussion
modules.summary: Repository sources + typed map → inspect → discuss in owning chat → review proposal → Apply to draft → Save. Context-scoped state and revision checks protect draft and disk boundaries.

modules.name: Trace normalization
modules.summary: Recorded JSONL or explicit thread exports become inspectable trace events. Curated cases join episodes, revisions and assessments to exact source evidence; exports retain hashes and coverage limits.

modules.name: Session review
modules.summary: ReviewDocument drives conversation, recorded-action, process, story and revision-comparison views. Authored interpretation remains distinguishable from recorded events and missing evidence.

modules.name: Usage analysis
modules.summary: Local session logs → incremental index → deduplicated usage records → dashboard and trace navigation. Coverage gaps and provenance accompany metrics; configurable price estimates are not billing authority.

modules.name: Personal instructions
modules.summary: One core routes build-time practice reads. Guarded sync installs reviewed sources at user scope; project contracts retain authority.

modules.name: MCP interaction example
modules.summary: Real tool/resource operations and host capabilities with a four-role sequence, bounded event log and explicit fixture/live provenance.

modules.name: Reports host
modules.summary: Standalone and MCP report surfaces share session-review and usage evidence; transport and host capabilities remain adapters.

connections.label: Review evidence
connections.description: Local, upstream and downstream observations inform an explicit owner decision; recency does not establish authority.

connections.label: Promote skill behavior
connections.description: Owner approval selects the smallest justified product change. This relationship describes governance, not an automatic runtime pipeline.

connections.label: Promote portable governance
connections.description: Owner approval selects the smallest justified product change. This relationship describes governance, not an automatic runtime pipeline.

connections.label: Promote executable tools
connections.description: Owner approval selects the smallest justified product change. This relationship describes governance, not an automatic runtime pipeline.

connections.label: Standalone user sync
connections.description: Locked skill content is installed once for the user; project-specific instructions and specialized skills remain local.

connections.label: Copier reconciliation
connections.description: Deliver managed files against recorded _commit; preserve _skip_if_exists bindings, review conflicts and run consumer checks.

connections.label: Optional npm/plugin install
connections.description: Prebuilt tool behavior is delivered independently; saved maps and case evidence stay in target repositories.

connections.label: Configure enforcement
connections.description: Consumer config supplies paths, document classes, language profiles and symlink definitions to portable checks.

connections.label: ReviewDocument + evidence
connections.description: Normalized source events and curated cases feed shared presentation; source truncation and authored assessments remain explicit.

connections.label: Inspect recorded trace
connections.description: Usage serve mode provides trace inspection through the shared session-review renderer.

annotations.text: Accepted principle: information may cross boundaries freely; authority crosses only through an explicit owner decision. Campaigns coordinate but own no work, evidence or decisions.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: ADR-0006 explicitly supersedes ADR-0003's shared-skill delivery clause. Current copier.yml exports template/ only; generic skills use scripts/skills.py. Keep ADR-0003's consumer ownership/baseline rationale.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Start here: (1) Improve a shared workflow: candidate → owner review → locked skill sync. (2) Adopt/update governance: reviewed revision → Copier → preserved local bindings → consumer checks. (3) Discuss architecture: inspect sources → proposal → Apply → Save. (4) Explain recorded work: scoped logs/exports + case → review views; usage adds aggregate evidence.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Initial source review: 435c554, 21 October 2026. Reconciled on 23 October against 43a08a4 and the reviewed skill/practice additions: v3 format, current source paths and delivery owners. This map is a discussion projection, not a dependency inventory or native acceptance report.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Named multi-view maps, freeform regions and richer architecture comparisons remain design proposals. Current source and canvas-design.md own supported behavior.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Implementation and documented behavior are source-backed; this architecture-authoring pass did not reinstall tools or run host/browser acceptance. Package/config discovery does not prove desktop activation. Native-host and restart-dependent acceptance limits are tracked in docs/migrations/repo-workbench.md; this map does not certify them.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Apply modifies only the draft. Save is a separate revision-checked repository write. Plugin runtime/cache paths never own the target repository's durable architecture.
annotations.author: agent
